name: Nippon Seiki Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Seiki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and selling automotive, motorcycle, and general-purpose instruments, consumer electronics instruments, resin materials, and automobiles in Japan, the Americas, Europe, and the rest of Asia. It operates through four segments: Automotive Parts Business, Consumer Parts Business, Resin Compound Business, and Automobile Sales Segment.
